info.title: ZipZap API
info.description:
Logistics operating system for e-commerce fulfillment and last-mile delivery.

Models a real courier business end to end: order, pricing, pickup,
origin hub, line-haul, destination hub, last-mile, COD, settlement.

## Credentials

Every `/v1` endpoint except `auth/login` and the public `/track` routes needs a
credential. Two forms work on the same `Authorization` header:

- `Authorization: Bearer <session-token>` — a session from `POST /v1/auth/login`.
- `Authorization: ApiKey <key-id>.<secret>` — a machine principal.

A browser signed in through a ZipZap console sends `Cookie: zipzap_session=<token>`
instead; see `docs/api/auth.md`.

## What an operation requires

`x-required-scopes` lists the scope(s) the operation enforces, taken from its own
`ScopeGuard` rather than restated by hand. `x-rate-limit` names the bucket it draws from
and whether that bucket closes or opens when Redis is unreachable.

## Errors

Every failure is the §87 envelope described by `ErrorEnvelopeDto`: `type`, `title`,
`status`, `code`, `detail`, `request_id`. Switch on `code`; `title` and `detail` are
prose and may be reworded. Nothing else is ever returned as an error body.

## Money

Integer minor units (poisha) plus a currency. Per-row amounts are JSON numbers with
`type: integer`; aggregates are decimal strings, because a sum can exceed what a JSON
number represents exactly. Never a float — see `docs/ADR/0009-money-representation.md`.

## Idempotency

Mutations listed in `docs/api/idempotency.md` require an `Idempotency-Key` header.
Replaying the same key returns the original result rather than applying the mutation
twice.

byStatus.description: Count per COD status. Every status is a key; unseen ones are 0, not absent.

available.description: Online with no job in hand.

byStatus.description: Count per rider status. Every status is a key; unseen ones are 0, not absent.

rate.description: delivered / (delivered + failed). Null when the window resolved no delivery.
returned / delivered. Null when the window saw no delivery.

collectionRate.description: collected / expected. Null when nothing was expected in the window.

parcelsWaiting.description: Parcels sitting at this hub right now.

staleSeconds.description: Seconds since the rider’s last ping. 0 is live.

ridersWithoutPosition.description: Riders with no ping yet. Counted, not plotted — a dot at (0,0) is in the ocean.

currency.description: Null when no COD was recorded that day

expectedMinor.description: Expected COD in minor units (poisha), as a string

collectedMinor.description: Collected COD in minor units (poisha), as a string

settledMinor.description: Settled COD in minor units (poisha), as a string

from.description: First day of the requested window, inclusive

to.description: Last day of the requested window, inclusive

codAmountMinor.description: Cash to collect, in integer minor units (poisha). Zero means prepaid: nothing to take.

codCurrency.description: Currency of the cash to collect.

shipment.description: What to collect and in which currency, read from the shipment that owns the parcel. Without it a rider is asked for cash without being told how much.

recipient.description: Who to call and where to go. `phone` is null only when the shipment carries no number; the rider app says so rather than offering a call that cannot connect.

pickups.description: Pickup batches assigned to this rider, newest first

deliveries.description: Delivery jobs assigned to this rider, newest first, each carrying what to collect and who to call — read through `SHIPMENT_HANDOFF_LOOKUP` because the parcel lives in shipment’s schema and a module may not join across it

totalEarningsMinor.description: Total earnings in integer minor units (poisha), summed from completed deliveries. Projection from delivery count × base fee; never stored, rebuilt on every read.

completedDeliveries.description: Count of completed deliveries contributing to this total.

asOf.description: Server timestamp when this projection was computed. Use this to detect stale client-side cached figures.
